project_type: Laravel 11 + Filament 3.x admin panel (Arabic RTL); SQLite in-memory for tests; single-database
build_system: Composer; post-autoload-dump runs `php artisan filament:upgrade`; no npm build step required for server-side widgets
test_framework: Pest 3 + pest-plugin-laravel; run with `./vendor/bin/pest tests/ --compact` or `./vendor/bin/pest tests/Feature/Phase5Test.php --compact`
build_command: composer dump-autoload && php artisan config:clear && php artisan route:clear && php artisan optimize:clear
verification_instructions: 1) php artisan config:clear && php artisan optimize:clear  2) php artisan route:list | grep admin  3) ./vendor/bin/pest tests/ --compact — expect all assertions pass
environment_constraints: DB_CONNECTION=sqlite, DB_DATABASE=:memory: in phpunit.xml. Spatie Permission uses teams; never check roles/permissions without calling setPermissionsTeamId($orgId) first. OrganizationScope is a global scope on Organization, Employee, LeaveRequest — always call ::withoutGlobalScopes() in service queries. No dev server restart needed.
contribution_requirements: Arabic labels/headings throughout. All DB queries in DashboardStatsService must use LeaveRequest::withoutGlobalScopes() and Organization::withoutGlobalScopes(). Scope by path LIKE $org->path.'%'. No Auth::user() inside service methods — accept Organization/User as parameters.
key_patterns: 1) subtreeIds(): Organization::withoutGlobalScopes()->where('path','like',$org->path.'%')->pluck('id')->all()  2) LeaveStatus enum: DRAFT/SUBMITTED/IN_REVIEW/RETURNED/APPROVED/REJECTED/CANCELLED — each has label() and color()  3) Filament discoverWidgets() from app/Filament/Widgets/ recursively — subdirectory widgets are auto-discovered  4) StatsOverviewWidget uses getStats() returning array of Stat objects  5) TableWidget uses table(Table $table): Table with ->query() and ->columns()  6) ChartWidget uses getData() returning ['datasets'=>[['label'=>'...','data'=>[...]]],'labels'=>[...]]  7) canView() on widgets is static method  8) LeaveBalance has no global scope — query directly with employee join  9) LeaveRequestFactory states: submitted(), inReview(), approved(), rejected(), forEmployee(Employee)  10) createHierarchy() in Pest.php returns ['directorate','administration','school'] — paths are observer-built on create  11) PDF generation: Barryvdh\DomPDF\Facade\Pdf::loadView()->output() returns binary string  12) Excel export: Maatwebsite\Excel\Facades\Excel::download(new LeaveRequestsExport($filters), 'file.xlsx')
directory_structure: app/Services/ — existing: LeaveRequestService, LeaveBalanceService, LeaveRequestPdfService, DTO/; app/Filament/Resources/ — 6 resources (auto-discovered); app/Filament/Widgets/ — empty, auto-discovered recursively; app/Filament/Pages/ — empty, auto-discovered; resources/views/pdf/ — leave-request.blade.php; tests/Feature/ — Phase1–4 tests; database/factories/ — all model factories including LeaveRequestFactory with states
